name: zoomTo
description: Move the map center to specific coordinates, optionally setting the zoom level. Coordinates are assumed to be in EPSG:4326 (WGS84 lat/lon) by default. Use 'srs' to specify a different SRS if needed.

lat.description: Latitude (Y coordinate) in EPSG:4326 by default

lon.description: Longitude (X coordinate) in EPSG:4326 by default

srs.description: Source SRS of the coordinates (default: 'EPSG:4326'). The map will transform them to its own projection.
